summary: Eleven blocks: a peach head, two cards for employers and candidates, a four-step process, a job listing of cards, a "no matching role" split with action cards, benefit lists, project cards, team photos, a testimonials block and a dark application form. Needs open roles with count, type and place (one real role is enough), four process steps and benefits.

sections.note: peach ground; small script tag, large black title with a short line and one orange pill button left; an illustration at the right edge
two grey rounded cards side by side (employers, candidates), each a heading, one sentence and an orange pill button
tag and centered heading with an orange word; four steps, each an orange round icon, a number and title and one line
(measured as job-list) heading; role cards of about 400px in a row: round red icon, title, number of positions, a small level tag, then job type, place and an orange View JD pill
no-match block: left light half with heading and text, right dark half holding two white action cards (leave details, refer a friend) with an accordion line and orange button
tag and centered heading; three grey cards, each with a round orange icon, a title and a bullet list (perks, health, fun)
heading and paragraph, then three white cards with an orange icon
team photo mosaic with a heading
heading and three cards with portrait, quote and name
dark band: heading, a short line and a list of three contact rows left; form right (name, email, role, message, CV upload)
